node.statement: Proposition 2.5 (Partial trace-SWAP factorization): Let M act on registers A1, B1. Then tr_{B1 B2}(M_{A1B1} tensor I_{A2B2} * SWAP_{AB}) = (tr_{B1}(M_{A1B1}) tensor I_{A2}) * SWAP_A. This combines Proposition 2.4 with Proposition 2.6 (permutation factorization P_{AB}(pi) = P_A(pi) tensor P_B(pi)).
